import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

<Aside type="note" title="Scope">
This is the **as-built** maintainer reference for the inbound side of the
contribution loop — a fork→PR landing back on a shared harness. The outbound
side (a Cup opening a fork→PR) is covered under the contribution/platform docs.
Design rationale lives in the source plans (`pr-system-completion-dogfood`,
`papercusp-dogfood-phase7-pr-lifecycle`); this page is the wiring + invariants.
</Aside>

## The loop at a glance

```
 new/updated PR on a shared harness (pr_reviewer_role_enabled)
        │
   [poll daemon]  system:pr-poll routine (per harness, ~60s + exp backoff)
        │  list open PRs → diff vs last-seen (routine metadata)
        │  per NEW/CHANGED PR:
        │    • getPr + fetch check-runs → refresh pr_check_status_cache
        │    • upsert harness_feature_prs            (WI↔PR producer)
        │    • trigger the agent-reviewer            (in-process or blueprint)
        ▼
   [agent-reviewer]  runPrReviewTask → report {summary, recommendation,
        │            rationale, risks, checksObserved}  → pr_review_reports
        ▼
   decideAutoReview(pr, settings)  +  report gate  +  revocation gate
        │   (auto mode, all gates pass)
        ▼
   tryAutoApprove → tryAutoMerge → stampCompletionRefOnMerge
        │                                   │
        ▼                                   ▼
   GitHub review/merge              feature status='shipped' +
                                    harness_feature_prs.pr_state='merged'
```

## Components

| Stage | Module | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Poll daemon** | `pr-host/poll-daemon.ts` (`system:pr-poll`, seeded by `pr-poll-routine.ts`) | The spine. Per harness with the reviewer role enabled, lists open PRs, diffs against a `last_seen` `{updated_at, head_sha}` snapshot on the routine metadata, and drives the per-PR flow. 60s cadence + exponential backoff (`retry-policy-types.ts`) on host errors; crash-safe (one durable step, idempotent). Registered via `registerSystemAction('pr-poll', …)` like git-sync. |
| **WI↔PR producer** | `harness/feature-pr-producer.ts` | `upsertFeaturePrOnOpen` / `markFeaturePrState` link a feature ↔ its PR ↔ state, recording the human operator's `author_github_user_id` (per-operator identity), `COALESCE`'d on conflict so a later poll can't wipe the operator attribution. The daemon also best-effort upserts a row, but writes only state/url (no author id), so a subsequent daemon poll can't overwrite the at-open attribution. |
| **Agent reviewer** | `pr-host/agent-reviewer.ts` + `pr-review-report-types.ts` | `runPrReviewTask` reviews the PR diff and emits a safety-guarded report. `assembleReport` forces the recommendation no more permissive than the facts: a suspected secret → `reject`, failing checks / empty diff → `request_changes` (the LLM can never talk these down). Default model `claude-sonnet-4-6` (override per-deploy with `PAPERCUSP_PR_REVIEW_MODEL`), run `anthropic-direct` at temperature `0` with a 90s abort timeout and a 1500-token output budget. The model sees a diff bounded to 60k chars (`DEFAULT_MAX_DIFF_CHARS`), but the deterministic secret/test/file scans still run over the **full** diff — so the safety floors hold even when the prompt is truncated (`diff_truncated` flags only the prompt budget, not the scans). Stored in `pr_review_reports`. |
| **Decision gate** | `pr-host/auto-review-decision-types.ts` (`decideAutoReview`) | Pure gate: role-enabled → `auto_review` → PR open → not draft → not self-authored → author trusted → not already-approved / changes-requested → then (`auto_merge` ∧ checks-green ∧ mergeable) ⇒ `approve_and_merge`, else `approve`. |
| **Report + revocation gates** (in the daemon) | `poll-daemon.ts`, `contribution-admission.ts` | A **revoked** contributor's PR is refused before any auto-approve/merge action and before the report gate (`isPrAuthorRevoked`, S0). Note the loop order: the agent review itself is still *triggered* for a revoked author (`triggerReviewer` → `decideAutoReview` gate → `isAuthorRevoked` → report gate → approve/merge) — the review is harmless (it never posts or merges), so a revoked PR may have a report but never an auto-action. Then for a non-revoked author: report **absent** ⇒ *defer* (await the review; the PR is excluded from `last_seen` so the next poll re-checks) — never auto-approve before the agent reviews; report **non-approve** ⇒ veto; **approve** ⇒ proceed. The read is head_sha-aware (a report for an older diff reads as absent ⇒ defer + re-review). |
| **Approve / merge** | `pr-host/auto-approve.ts`, `auto-merge.ts` | Idempotent; both write `auto_review_audit`. Merge is `squash` by default, pinned with `expected_head_sha`. |
| **Completion stamp** | `harness/completion-ref-writer.ts` | On merge, `resolveMergedPrFeatureId` → `stampCompletionRefOnMerge`: feature `status='shipped'` + `completion_ref`. |
| **Report GUI + modes** | `apps/operator/app/harness/PrsTab.tsx` / `PrRow.tsx` + the `pr-reviewer-settings` route | Renders the agent report (recommendation chip, rationale, risks, observed checks) + the linked WI. **Manual** mode: a human reads the report and clicks Approve / Approve+merge. **Auto** mode: a claimed-owner-gated toggle. ON flips **three** settings — `pr_reviewer_role_enabled` (the master kill-switch that gates the whole auto path) **and** `auto_review` **and** `auto_merge`; OFF clears only `auto_review`/`auto_merge` and leaves the role enabled. The daemon then auto-applies. (The single owner-facing `autoModeOn` state is `role-enabled ∧ auto_review ∧ auto_merge`; granular per-lever control stays in the settings modal.) UI state that an agent/human may drive is URL-backed via nuqs: `prs_filter`, `prs_scope`, `prs_settings`, `prs_selected`, and `prs_report`. When the viewed harness belongs to a pot, `PrsTab` uses the audited `harnessProjects.lite` sync query plus `groupByHive` to expose a harness-vs-whole-pot scope; pot-scope rows route Approve / Approve+merge to the owning `member_slug`. Auto-status is shown only for open PRs on the viewed harness, because pot-scope rows from other members do not carry that member's auto-mode settings and merged/closed rows should not render misleading "blocked: not open" noise. |
| **Fork GC + dogfood witness** | `harness/fork-gc.ts`, `pr-host/dogfood-roundtrip.ts` | GC keeps a fork on merge, collects only abandoned operator-owned forks (dry-run by default). `verifyDogfoodRoundTrip` asserts the loop round-tripped (prTracked ∧ merged ∧ shipped ∧ linked). |

## S0 safety invariants

These are teeth-tested (`pr-host/*.test.ts`, `inbound-pipeline.test.ts`); keep them when editing the daemon:

1. **No auto-merge without checks-green + trusted author + `auto_merge` + not-revoked**, and — when a review report exists — a present `approve` report. `decideAutoReview` returns `approve_and_merge` only when checks are `success`; a red/pending/unknown check, untrusted/self/revoked author, or a `request_changes`/`reject` report can never reach `tryAutoMerge`.
2. **Fail-closed on a checks-fetch error** — if the check-run fetch errors, `checks_state` stays `unknown`, so the gate yields `approve` (never `approve_and_merge`); a checks-API outage cannot sneak a merge through. The safety here is a two-layer arrangement: `tryAutoMerge` on its own *permits* `checks_state=unknown` (it reads `unknown` as no-checks-configured), but the daemon never reaches it with `unknown` because `decideAutoReview` requires strictly `success` (`isChecksGreen` — `unknown` is **not** green) to return `approve_and_merge` — so `unknown` always degrades to approve-only.
3. **The agent never self-approves**, and **re-poll is idempotent** (the last-seen guard + `tryAutoApprove`/`tryAutoMerge` audit-state checks; a merged PR drops off the open list).
4. **First-sight race closed** — a brand-new trusted+green PR is *deferred*, not auto-merged, until its review report lands.
